title: Prospective64 conditional native same-photon peak study
state: frozen before generation; each stage needs root release
main_question: At this fixed native mean/cadence/noise setting, what changes in NIR distance error when the same photons determine a joint grizJH peak instead of supplying the true peak?
population_scope: Conditional distribution over native measurement noise only. No survey population, selection correction, historical reproduction, dust posterior or cosmology fit.

generation.data_precision: Native FITS MJD1D R8,flux/error1E R4. Source17digit ledger retains true and reported variance components,draws,flags and all signs.
generation.noiseless_reuse: Validated deterministic engineering control reused only with identical binaries/physical inputs; every new64 mean and true variance component must also exactly match engineering deterministic reference by physical epoch. First8 stochastic outcomes are not pooled.

estimands.per_draw: eta = assignedR4 jointpeak−truepeak; e0=D_NIR_truepeak−Dtruth; e1=D_NIR_assignedpeak−Dtruth; delta=e1−e0. InternalR8 eta and peakquantization separately retained.
estimands.summary: Mean, sampleSD(ddof1), MCSE(mean)=SD/sqrt64; rawsecondmoments and their sampleSD/sqrt64. No independent timing smear.
estimands.joint: Full samplecovariance(ddof1) for[eta,e0,e1,delta]; six rawcrossmoments with MCSE; covariance MCSE from delete-one jackknife. These finite-sample MC uncertainty estimates are conditional on the fixed model/noise experiment.
estimands.retention: All64 draws, signs and flags; failures tabulated and downstream estimation withheld on a gatefailure. No success-only mean, no replacement draws, no optional sample enlargement/stopping by effect.
estimands.engineering8: Never pooled into64 summaries. Previously observed paired effects did not select seed/truth/membership/gates.
